item.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval to Launch Pivotal Brain Implant Trial for ALS Patients
item.description: Neuralink has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to launch the LINK Pivotal Study, the first pivotal trial for an implantable brain-computer interface (BCI) in the United States. item.title: Two Italians killed in Kuwait drone strike; Iran denies involvement
item.description: Two Italian nationals were killed and two other workers wounded on Thursday when falling shrapnel from intercepted Iranian drones struck a vital site in Kuwait, according to Kuwait's Ministry of Defence. item.description: The new tariff proposal is an attempt by the Trump administration to replace sweeping tariffs that the Supreme Court invalidated, this time relying on a different legal authority — Section 301 — that is meant to counter specific unfair trade practices rather than serve as a broad negotiating tool.…

item.description: The Federal Reserve's preferred inflation measure accelerated to 3.8% in October, reinforcing expectations that the central bank will raise interest rates at its December meeting and raising questions about how much more tightening may be needed in 2027. item.description: Major League Baseball filed a lawsuit Wednesday against the MLB Players Association in federal court in the Southern District of New York, asking a judge to declare that a lockout would be legal and to prevent the union from dissolving its status as the players' bargaining representative. item.description: The Federal Communications Commission on Wednesday granted SpaceX conditional authorization to deploy a constellation of up to 1 million satellites designed to serve as orbital data centers.
